claim:
For the square-root cross-diffusion Lotka–Volterra PDE (27) of Broadbridge–Cherniha–Goard, let \(A=-d_{12}>0\), \(B=d_{21}>0\), \(k_1,k_2>0\), and let a Laplacian mode satisfy \(-\Delta\varphi=q^2\varphi\) with \(q^2\ge0\). The linearization at the positive homogeneous equilibrium \((k_1,k_2)\) has eigenvalues
\[
\lambda_\pm(q)=\pm i\omega(q),\qquad
\omega(q)^2=\left(1+\frac{Aq^2}{\sqrt{k_2}}\right)\left(1+\frac{Bq^2}{\sqrt{k_1}}\right).
\]
Thus every such spatial mode is spectrally neutral and its frequency strictly increases with \(q^2\); unlike the conventional diagonal-diffusion Lotka–Volterra PDE, every nonzero spatial mode lacks linear exponential damping. This claim concerns the linearized homogeneous-boundary problem only, not nonlinear stability or the paper's mixed-boundary example.

scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The determinant of the trace-zero off-diagonal modal matrix is positive and equals the product of two positive affine factors. Earlier source text inadvertently prefixed this determinant with a minus sign; the corrected formula and characteristic polynomial are consistent.
limitations: No nonlinear Lyapunov stability or global well-posedness conclusion is established.
The paper’s mixed, time-dependent boundary example is outside the claim.
The comparison model is the conventional Lotka–Volterra PDE with strictly positive diagonal diffusion coefficients.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Linear modal spectrum at the positive homogeneous equilibrium under common periodic or homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions.

scientific_scope: At the positive homogeneous equilibrium of equation (27), for common periodic or homogeneous Neumann boundaries, every nonnegative eigenvalue q² of -Δ is allowed. No nonlinear stability claim is made.
title: Neutral modal spectrum in a square-root cross-diffusion Lotka–Volterra system
